g.text: RS-422 uses separate transmit and receive wire pairs for full-duplex communication.

g.desc: RS-422 uses separate transmit and receive wire pairs for full-duplex communication.

g.text: RS-485 typically uses a single shared pair for half-duplex, multi-point networking.

g.desc: RS-485 typically uses a single shared pair for half-duplex, multi-point networking.

g.text: Since CRMI's wire protocol will only USE the bus in a half duplex manner, a 2-pair RS422

g.desc: Since CRMI's wire protocol will only USE the bus in a half duplex manner, a 2-pair RS422

g.text: bus driver can be configured into a 1-pair RS485 scheme by connecting the two pairs:

g.desc: bus driver can be configured into a 1-pair RS485 scheme by connecting the two pairs:

g.text: T+ to R+ and T- to R-.

g.desc: T+ to R+ and T- to R-.

g.text: In addition, on the software side, the CMRI protocol library must actively control the

g.desc: In addition, on the software side, the CMRI protocol library must actively control the

g.text: TXenable/~{RXenable} pins on the bus interface IC when used on a 1-pair bus

g.desc: TXenable/~{RXenable} pins on the bus interface IC when used on a 1-pair bus

g.text: Bias is used in a 1-pair half duplex RS485 wiring configuration.

g.desc: Bias is used in a 1-pair half duplex RS485 wiring configuration.

g.text: Biasing A+ to v+ and B- to GND ensures no RX "Null char noise" gets injected

g.desc: Biasing A+ to v+ and B- to GND ensures no RX "Null char noise" gets injected

g.text: if a bus driver is misconfigured to have ~{RE} tied to gnd

g.desc: if a bus driver is misconfigured to have ~{RE} tied to gnd

g.text: Only configure a single node to add bias if it is needed.

g.desc: Only configure a single node to add bias if it is needed.

g.text: Termination is a noise prevention requirement that prevents

g.desc: Termination is a noise prevention requirement that prevents

g.text: "ringing" when transmissions hit the end of a transmission line.

g.desc: "ringing" when transmissions hit the end of a transmission line.

g.text: The Shield wire is used ONLY in the cables between nodes

g.desc: The Shield wire is used ONLY in the cables between nodes

g.text: to reduce the impact of electrical noise on the bus. The shield

g.desc: to reduce the impact of electrical noise on the bus. The shield

g.text: should be connected to earth ground at ONE END Only. Do not connect

g.desc: should be connected to earth ground at ONE END Only. Do not connect

g.text: the shield to power supply GND.

g.desc: the shield to power supply GND.

g.text: Each pair used in the bus should be terminated at either end.

g.desc: Each pair used in the bus should be terminated at either end.

g.text: A 4-wire/2-pair RS422 bus uses both RX and TX terminations, one for each pair.

g.desc: A 4-wire/2-pair RS422 bus uses both RX and TX terminations, one for each pair.

g.text: A 2-wire/1-pair RS485 bus only needs one termination on the single A+/B- pair.

g.desc: A 2-wire/1-pair RS485 bus only needs one termination on the single A+/B- pair.
